points: Copper Home listens locally for "Hey Copper." Nothing is sent to the cloud until the wake word is detected.
After the wake word, the request is sent to the Copper Cloud and saved: 30 days on Free, 12 months on Copper Plus.
Copper Notes recordings are transcribed on the device. Transcripts and summaries are stored for 30 days on Free and 12 months on Copper Plus.
You can view and delete recordings, transcripts and Household Memory anytime in the Copper app.
Copper State Labs does not sell recordings, and doesn't use them to train models unless you opt in.
